Questions about Higher Ground

What is the doh of Higher Ground?

In this version, in G major, doh is G. If your choir sings it in another key, doh moves to the new key note and every solfa syllable stays the same — that is what movable doh means.

What note does Higher Ground start on?

It starts on s, (D in G major), a pickup before the first full bar. Find doh first, then sing up or down to s,.

What words can be sung to Higher Ground?

Higher Ground is in the metre 8.8.8.8 — Long Metre (L.M.): lines of 8, 8, 8, 8 syllables. Words written in the same metre fit it, such as 'Take Up Thy Cross', the Savior Said, 'Tis Midnight and on Olive's Brow, 'Twas on That Dark, That Doleful Night; check where the stresses fall before you sing them together.

Is Higher Ground in the public domain?

Yes. Charles Hutchinson Gabriel died in 1932; the tune was first published in 1902. Everyone named died before 1955 and it was published before 1929, so the tune is out of copyright in the UK, the EU, the United States and Nigeria. Modern arrangements of it can still be under copyright.
